Rasmus Haarup Lie is an anesthesiologist based at Aarhus University Hospital in the Central Denmark Region (Region Midtjylland) [^src1]. He represents the Danish Society of Anesthesiology and Intensive Care Medicine (Dansk Selskab for Anæstesiologi og Intensiv Medicin) [^src1]. 

Lie's primary significance in the provided corpus is his role on the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe]], the governing steering committee for the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) [^src1]. The AKDB is a national clinical database operating under the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. According to the 2023 AKDB annual report, the steering committee is composed of cross-disciplinary and cross-regional professionals who oversee the database's indicators and governance [^src1]. Lie's presence on the committee ensures dedicated anesthesiological representation and expertise, which is vital for evaluating clinical practices, addressing registration system challenges, and guiding quality audits related to acute surgical conditions such as perforated ulcers [^src1].
